subject: Render DELTA11/12 READY: blit completeness fixed; release+ASan PASS; new hashes
body:
Blit test abort was test-order/stride defect, not production copy: sRGB view aliases dst and mutated the 4x4 region before the full assertion; existing packed-row expectations also ignored 64-byte row padding. Fixed test order and stride-aware assertions without weakening checks. Moved test_texture_blits/test_mipmaps/test_blit_completeness before host split; both are now executed.

Production blit additions in blit_encoder.inc: buffer<->texture with row/image strides and all level/slice/origin bounds; texture<->texture regions/levels/slices/3D depth and n2t-compatible views; sync/optimize/fences; ordered CPU jobs and whole-command refusal before partial jobs. Existing fill/buffer-copy/mip paths retained.

Host evidence: release PASS and one ASan/UBSan PASS (rc0 both fake-JM binaries); full DELTA8/9/10 checks green. New hashes:
